# leptonica / affine_fuzzer

leptonica's own fuzz target `affine_fuzzer` ([source](source/affine_fuzzer.cc), unmodified), one of the targets OSS-Fuzz builds, over leptonica (DanBloomberg/leptonica at 10bdea2f).

pixReadMemSpix, then pixAffinePta / pixAffinePtaWithAlpha / pixAffineSequential with EMPTY point arrays (so the calls mostly error out early); outputs destroyed unchecked.

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against leptonica at commit 10bdea2f.
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
The harness makes no check of its own beyond not crashing, so a statement about it says only that the code it calls never crashes, hangs or trips a sanitizer.

## Builds
Static riscv64 Linux programs, compiled for RV64G and run as `<file> <input-file>`; `oft fetch leptonica` downloads the published ones and checks each against its SHA-256.

| build | file | bytes | sha256 |
|---|---|---:|---|
| plain | `affine_fuzzer.plain` | 959,544 | `bc50b3e6952f25f1d7acb2e88d80dd91795905482a76c1eee30205e144a660fd` |
| ubsan | `affine_fuzzer.ubsan` | 1,025,688 | `eca5b45523bdc44a5104389347985621227d721c03608ef32b0131bf85f5dc09` |
| asan | `affine_fuzzer.asan` | 1,889,224 | `905ffd0d846bf001f9d8df64166a09edee932aaf8da5208da6ad98fc6fa33fb5` |
| asan-ubsan | `affine_fuzzer.asan-ubsan` | 1,961,512 | `119ba127474e2f31bb1a53bd1ec10c6e5f41499f1421de9beb013480610494ed` |

Each build also links code that no sanitizer instruments, as its link recorded it. A statement about a sanitizer build covers that code only as uninstrumented code: ASan checks no load or store made inside it, and UBSan inserts no check there.

- plain: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libpng16.a` (a library from the build image), `libtiff.a` (a library from the build image), `libturbojpeg.a` (a library from the build image), `libz.a` (a library from the build image)

- asan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc++.a` (the C++ runtime), `libc.a` (the C library), `libpng16.a` (a library from the build image), `libtiff.a` (a library from the build image), `libturbojpeg.a` (a library from the build image), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime), `libz.a` (a library from the build image)
